title: A π–π 3D network of tetranuclear μ2/μ3-carbonato Dy(III) bis-pyrazolylpyridine clusters showing single molecule magnetism features

material_class.structural_family: tetranuclear trigonal-pyramidal μ2/μ3-carbonato Dy4 cluster assembled into a π–π (4^9·6^6) acs 3D network

synthesis.procedure: Dy(NO3)3·xH2O (228.3 mg, 0.5 mmol based on Dy(NO3)3·6H2O) and 3-bpp (105.6 mg, 0.5 mmol) were dissolved in MeOH (10 ml). After full dissolution, NEt3 (0.14 ml, 101.2 mg, 1 mmol) was added and the mixture was stirred for 2 h. The resulting pale yellow precipitate was dissolved in 5 ml DMSO and left in a vial open to air. X-ray quality hexagonal prismatic colourless crystals formed after 3 weeks (main text also notes two weeks under aerobic conditions) with an approximate yield of 25%. Carbonate ligands arise from atmospheric CO2 fixation.
synthesis.time: stirred 2 h in MeOH; crystals after 3 weeks in DMSO (main text: two weeks under aerobic conditions)
synthesis.vessel_or_method: vial open to air; aerobic atmospheric CO2 fixation
synthesis.workup_and_crystallization: pale yellow precipitate from MeOH/NEt3 was redissolved in DMSO and left open to air; hexagonal prismatic colourless crystals of X-ray quality

properties.summary: DC susceptibility of the Dy4 cluster matches four uncoupled DyIII ions at room temperature (χMT = 54.5 cm3 K mol−1). Low-T χMT downturn in 10 kOe is ascribed to Stark-level depopulation; weaker-field data show a χMT upturn below ~5 K. Curie–Weiss θ values are small and negative. Magnetization does not saturate (21.32 Nβ at 5 T, 2 K) and M vs H/T curves do not superimpose, indicating anisotropy. AC susceptibility in zero DC field is frequency-dependent (χM″ = 1.13 cm3 mol−1 at 1500 Hz, 2 K), with estimated Ea ~ 5.5 K and τ0 ~ 10−6 s, consistent with slow magnetisation reversal/SMM features.
